notes.title: Update 13th February 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Todays Update contains new lobby features and bugfixes: 

- you can now directly start all kinds of games from a lobby
- Starting friendly games from lobby does not require adding users to friend list.
- ranking points limit in steps of 50
- +- 500 ranking points limit
- fast or regular time window
- auto start after lobby complete – 60 sec

- filter lobbies with friends
- filter ranked / casual
- filter fast or regular time window
- filter for number of slots
- filter Lobby-Name
- filter for incomplete lobbies

- sort by random, newest, oldest, fullest and emptiest
- fast join (Fast mode Lobbys stay open as long as you keep the app open. If you close the app all own fast mode Lobbys will be closed and left.)

- Bugfix: Game over not showing after surrender
- Bugfix: Ranking points on game over screen
- Bugfix: Games not removable from running games list

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27031928/fba9060070b1b3e726d90fc1ff84deb0771edb54.jpg

Thank you for your patience and for helping us to improve the game by sending bug reports and giving us feedback! 

Your Team DIGIDICED

notes.title: Lobby Room Upgrade
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Currently we are testing our new Lobby Room Upgrade.
It will contain the following features:

 - Lobby functions ( rebalanced tiles / fast join/  ranking points limit 50 steps +- 500/ (fast/ regular time window) (auto start 60 sec))

 - Filter ( rebalanced tiles / lobbies with friends / ranked / casual / fast or regular time window )

 - Lobby Name Filter (Hiding full lobbys and defining number of slots (Not in the screenshots yet))

Here is a first look: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27031928/ad977c7201bf4bf5f7f017f1f5c2c5098d945688.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27031928/8c4f600b74b2f3f0bcb6aa4e115f6683e5c4aa72.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27031928/59e61f8d090de3402d3119a0a93f1277600e1371.jpg

Apart from that we fixed following issues in this version: 
-fixed game over not showing after surrender
-fixed ranking points on game over screen

We hope to share this features and fixes with you soon, after having them tested! 

And lastly: We added an explanation on how our ranking system works to our FAQ's. You can find it on this page: 
https://digidiced.com/faqs/
"How does the ranking system work?"

notes.title: Update - 14.11.2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Todays Update contains the following changes and fixes: 


 PC version adjustment: Your own board is always on the left
 Games can now be skipped with the next game button
 Fixed: replay showing unnecessary passes
 Fixed: next game button not showing up when a new turn comes in
 Fixed: score not showing correctly in running games
 Fixed: tile preview showing all zeros when loading into a game

notes.title: Update - 3rd November 2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
Todays Update will contain the following:


 Fixed: Loading screen stuck for some users
 Fixed: Next Game Button flawed
 Game Timer reimplemented
 Legacy Ranking implemented
 Timer in ranked games back to old values
 Prominent usernames in the chat lobby

notes.title: Here is what's is new!
notes.content:
New UI version in order to cover any solutions on smartphones and tablets
 New PC UI Setup so that it is possible to see the opponents blanket.
 New rebalanced tiles by Tysen Streib (new game mode option)
 New Mainmenu with Chat Lobby & Lobby creation / extended profile / better save game handling / new backend 
 New Handling of tiles skins: random and faithful to the boardgame 
 New Challenge with additional and optimized AI levels (5)
 New Themes available: Halloween.
 We will now step by step implement the official themes.

notes.title: Important News about the upcoming migration!
notes.content:
Dear User,
as we already informed you, we are migrating an upgraded version of Patchwork to our new server. Patchwork is one of our oldest games... actually the second we produced since the founding... and we are really happy with the new features patchwork will have.

It will go live this weekend (29-30 Oct 22)! Because of that we have some important news for you. Some data will not be migrated and we will start a new ranked season!

You can have a look at our new feature list here:
https://digidiced.com/patchwork/

Follow this link in order to learn more about the migration itself:
https://digidiced.com/patchwork-cc/

Your DIGIDICED Team
